# Sprite artwork credits

Downloaded Goku and Vegeta sheets from the public assets of Mitchell Jay Street’s 2D Dragonball Game:
https://github.com/MitchStreet/2D-Dragonball-Game

Source game: Dragon Ball Z: Legendary Super Warriors (GBC).
Rippers: Jay Ibero (Yajirobe), Majin Aussie, Grim, Bonzai.
Edits and colour correction: Son Goharotto / enpitsudo-dojo.com.
Additional contributors are credited in the original sheets, which are retained unchanged.

The sprite art is third-party artwork; it is not presented as Princewill’s original art. The Canvas renderer, combat rules and procedural stage drawings were created for this project. Dragon Ball characters and source-game artwork belong to their respective owners.
